INDmoney already has a great interface and a dedicated F&O section. It would be even better with F&O-specific filters like Top Gainers, Top Losers, Volume/OI, and Bullish/Bearish. Currently, after finding an F&O stock, we still have to open the option chain separately to identify the relevant CALL or PUT. A one-click F&O experience, where the most relevant CALL/PUT with strike and expiry is shown instantly, would make trading much faster. Please consider adding this in a future update 🙏

weekly_pulse.note: User feedback over the past 10 weeks highlights persistent issues with customer support, with many users reporting unhelpful chat-based support and long resolution times. App performance has seen significant improvements, with users praising faster downloads and increased stability, though some still experience syncing disruptions. Feature requests are varied, with strong demand for enhanced F&O trading tools, better bond tracking, and improved onboarding processes. KYC and account opening remain a pain point for some. Addressing customer support responsiveness and refining the onboarding flow are key priorities.
actions: Implement a tiered customer support system to escalate complex issues beyond the chatbot and ensure timely human intervention for critical problems.
Conduct a thorough review of the KYC process to identify and fix bugs or workflow inefficiencies that lead to repeated requests for documentation.
Prioritize the development of F&O-specific filters (Top Gainers, Top Losers, Volume/OI) and a one-click CALL/PUT selection feature to enhance the trading experience.

fee_scenario: Mutual Fund Exit Load on INDmoney Platform
explanation_bullets: An exit load is a charge levied by a mutual fund house when an investor redeems their units before a specified period.
The exit load percentage and the holding period for its applicability are determined by the respective mutual fund scheme, not by the INDmoney platform.
INDmoney displays the exit load details for each mutual fund scheme, including the applicable percentage and the tenure, within the app.
If an investor redeems units of a mutual fund scheme before the exit load period expires, the calculated exit load amount will be deducted from the redemption proceeds.
The exit load is a fee charged by the mutual fund Asset Management Company (AMC) and is not a fee charged by INDmoney for facilitating the transaction.
